Title: Azure Monitor for SAP Solutions is now available in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for SAP Solutions is a new Azure-native monitoring product for customers running SAP landscapes on Azure. It’s now available in public preview in US East, US East 2, US West 2, and West Eu regions.

Collect and consolidate telemetry data from Azure infrastructure and databases in one central location, regardless of the underlying infrastructure (Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Large Instances, or both). Use this data to visually correlate telemetry between different components for faster troubleshooting.
